title: Illustration / Flat style — Design

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; interactive elements retain their captured state

slide_intent: Preserve the distinction between shapes and lines, because minimum size and separation determine whether a flat illustration reads as bold geometry or fine detail.
strategic_value: Consistent geometric construction can make IBM’s colorful flat images feel related even when their subjects vary.
demonstration: Bold examples lead into primitive-shape combinations, 8px size and spacing diagrams, grid snapping, layering, curves, radii and shading.
practical_value: Construct the subject from basic shapes and inspect minimum dimensions and intersections before refining its color.

content_islands.name: Flat-style family
content_islands.spec: Open with a purple technical scene, finger and eye graphics, a face and smaller geometric illustrations.

content_islands.name: Shape foundations
content_islands.spec: Show primitive variations and how squares and circles form an eye and a heart.

content_islands.name: Size, grid and layering
content_islands.spec: Compare spacing, show an 8px overlay, and pair correct and incorrect snapped and overlapping shapes.

content_islands.name: Drawing geometry
content_islands.spec: Reveal the face’s underlying circles, then standard angles, circular and organic curves, and nested rounded corners.

content_islands.name: Color and definition
content_islands.spec: Close with gradient/shading examples and an opaque-color treatment that implies overlap.

ingredient.name: Flat-style minimum geometry
ingredient.role: Keep shapes distinct and retain bold graphic character.
ingredient.application: Build on the 8px grid; keep objects and negative spaces at least 8px; preserve at least an 8px safe area when layering shapes.
ingredient.scope: IBM flat-style illustration construction. The page separately recommends standard angles while allowing intentional organic curves.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explains that elements smaller than 8px read as lines and change the character of flat illustration.
reference_purposes.Expression: The bold face, hand and technology images demonstrate IBM’s flat geometric treatment.
reference_purposes.Application: Primitive diagrams and paired construction examples show how to build and layer objects.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Flat-style objects and negative spaces have an 8px minimum; the grid and overlap safe area are also specified at 8px.
